notes.title: Love cracking locks? Check out Museum of Mechanics: Lockpicking
notes.notes:
Museum of Mechanics: Lockpicking is a wonderful little idea to bring together many different ways to crack locks from various styles in video games.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/01/love-cracking-locks-check-out-museum-of-mechanics-lockpicking

notes.title: New options
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

After some requests I added a Y-Invert option and a resolution dropdown to the options for the museum. Please let me know if you encounter any problems.
